posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Bryce Harper is sixth in the majors in OPS. He’s played in every game. He’s reached base in 34 straight games with a .521 OBP in his last 26 games. He’s doing it in a way that has set the tone for an entire Phillies team on a heater:  www.nytimes.com/athletic/755...
posts.jp: Bryce HarperはメジャーでOPSが6位。全試合に出場している。34試合連続で出塁し、直近26試合ではOBP.521。火の玉状態のフィリーズ全体の流れを作る活躍をしている。
